channel.title: Texas Solutions Truck Dispatch Blog
channel.description: Truck dispatch, rates, diesel prices and fuel-saving guides for owner-operators and small fleets.

item.title: What Is Deadhead in Trucking and How to Reduce It
item.description: Deadhead miles are empty miles with no paid freight. See how they cut your effective rate per mile and 7 practical ways owner-operators reduce them.

item.title: What Is a Good Rate Per Mile in Trucking in 2026?
item.description: A good rate per mile beats your cost per mile with profit left over. See rough 2026 rates for dry van, reefer, flatbed, hotshot and box truck, and find yours.

item.title: Truck Dispatcher vs Freight Broker: The Real Difference
item.description: A truck dispatcher works for the carrier; a freight broker connects shippers and carriers. Compare who they work for, pay and authority.

item.title: IFTA for Owner-Operators: How to File Quarterly Returns
item.description: IFTA explained for owner-operators: who needs it, what records to keep, quarterly due dates, and how net taxable gallons are calculated by state.

item.title: How to Get Your MC Number and Trucking Authority
item.description: Step-by-step guide for new owner-operators: USDOT number, MC operating authority, BOC-3, insurance filing, UCR, and what to set up before you haul.

item.title: Hours of Service Rules Explained: 11, 14 and 70-Hour
item.description: FMCSA hours-of-service rules in plain English: 11-hour driving limit, 14-hour window, 30-minute break, 60/70-hour cycle and the 34-hour restart.

item.title: Freight Factoring for Owner-Operators: How It Works
item.description: How freight factoring works for truckers: advances, fees, recourse vs non-recourse, notice of assignment, and how to compare factoring companies.

item.title: Dry Van vs Reefer vs Flatbed: Which Trailer Pays Best?
item.description: Compare dry van, reefer and flatbed for owner-operators: rates per mile, demand, extra work and costs, so you can choose the trailer that fits your goals.

item.title: Cost of Running a Semi Truck Per Mile (2026 Breakdown)
item.description: What it costs to run a semi per mile: the ATRI industry average, fixed vs variable costs, and how to calculate your own cost per mile before you book.

item.title: Best Load Boards for Owner-Operators and How to Use Them
item.description: How to choose a load board: DAT, Truckstop, 123Loadboard and others compared by features, plus tips to vet brokers and avoid freight scams.

item.title: How Much Does a Truck Dispatcher Cost in 2026?
item.description: Truck dispatch fees explained: typical 3-10% of weekly gross, what the fee covers, and Texas Solutions rates of 5% semi, 8% hotshot and 10% box truck.

item.title: Hotshot Trucking Rates Per Mile, Fuel and Dispatch (2026)
item.description: Hotshot rates per mile, fuel mileage by load weight, what a hotshot dispatcher does, and what dispatch costs: 8% of weekly gross at Texas Solutions.

item.title: Diesel Prices by State: How Truckers Cut Fuel Cost Per Mile
item.description: Why diesel prices differ by state, how to work out fuel cost per mile, and 7 ways truckers cut fuel spend. Free fuel calculator and daily state prices.

item.title: Box Truck Dispatch: How to Find Loads and What It Really Costs
item.description: How box truck owner-operators find loads, what they spend on fuel, and what box truck dispatch costs: 10% of weekly gross at Texas Solutions.
